nodes.label: Show, don't lecture
nodes.rationale: Reader should feel the 68 meters before reading the number; experience precedes explanation so understanding is earned, not lectured.

nodes.label: Diegetic UI
nodes.rationale: HUD elements belong to the car; timestamps and locations are story, not chrome, to preserve the night-drive documentary immersion.

nodes.label: Choices leave marks
nodes.rationale: Every decision changes state the reader sees again at the debrief, making consequences personal.

nodes.label: Data is the drama
nodes.rationale: Real reaction-time, takeover, and liability figures are the payload of every outcome; statistics carry the drama rather than gamification.

nodes.label: Portable by construction
nodes.rationale: One HTML file per chapter, everything inlined, works from file:// — no build step, assets, or server required.

nodes.label: L2 ≠ autonomous
nodes.rationale: Core success criterion: a reader can articulate why Level 2 assistance is not autonomy without being lectured.

nodes.label: Accessibility & inclusion
nodes.rationale: Full keyboard path, prefers-reduced-motion support, ≥4.5:1 body contrast, no flashing above 3 Hz.

nodes.label: Cinematic, grounded, sober brand
nodes.rationale: A night-drive documentary, not a quiz app; the interface never celebrates or gamifies a crash.
